**About The Role**
 You will build internal AI operations tooling that helps operational teams work more effectively. You will create agents, workflows, and custom tools; evaluate third\-party products; support self\-service deployment; implement internal APIs, authentication, and MCP patterns; integrate customer\-experience systems; and work with operations stakeholders to identify new challenges.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 2\+ years of full\-stack software engineering experience
* Experience building, maintaining, and supporting internal tools or systems
* Agentic coding practices and tools
* Experience in early\-stage 0→1 environments
* Agent frameworks such as LangGraph
* Evaluation or observability tools such as LangSmith and Braintrust
* Support tooling, CRM systems, or workflow automation platforms
* Eligibility to work in the US


**Responsibilities**
* Build agents, workflows, and custom tools for non\-engineering teams
* Evaluate and integrate third\-party tools
* Contribute to the self\-service app deployment platform
* Design and implement internal APIs, authentication, and MCP patterns
* Extend systems beyond the Django monolith
* Integrate and scale customer experience systems such as Zendesk
* Partner with customer experience, legal, finance, people, and content operations stakeholders


**Benefits**
* Equity package
* 401(k) with 3% employer match
* Roth 401(k)
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* 11 paid holidays
* Unlimited PTO
* Sick time
* 16 weeks of paid parental leave
* Creative education stipend
* Commuter allowance
* In\-office lunch
